_note: WSR collision-mesh truth in the app's map frame (250x304 minimap, fractional coords). Generated by tools/wsr-truth.mjs from the meshes + tools/mesh-registration.json; consumed by tools/build-derived.mjs. grid = 9x9 [dx,dy] downhill, +x right +y down, normalized to the green's own steepest cell (extract-greens.mjs convention, physical spacing); gridPct = the same in percent slope.
